summary: Rope::remove() unnecessarily requested a subsequent repair traversal based on the current node's child count, even when local merging resolved the undersized nodes. The fix instead checks whether an affected child remains undersized after merging, preserving repair requests from deeper recursion. The commit explicitly describes a performance regression without a correctness failure. Its added test, rope::tests::remove_05, checks resulting text and tree invariants, not unnecessary repair work. Inspection of existing removal tests found no detecting performance assertion, so test is empty and the candidate should remain blocked. The proposed implementation regions are exact, unique Git-source regions covering both corrected branches. No tests were executed.
